name: Token Plains
subtitle: where every journey starts with a single token
signs:
A D  or  ← →   MOVE
SPACE  or  W   JUMP

BUGS!  jump on them
or press X to SPIN

HOLD SPACE IN THE AIR
TO HOVER — the jet hurts too

IN THE AIR:  S  or  ↓  =  GROUND POUND
it breaks corrupted data

name: Gradient Caves
subtitle: descend, little by little
signs:
IT IS DARK DOWN HERE
sparks glow — follow them

CORRUPTED FLOOR
↓ in the air to pound through

name: Context Window
subtitle: the window is closing — climb!
signs:
THE CONTEXT WINDOW IS CLOSING
climb before null catches you

name: The Hallucination
subtitle: it is very sure about things that are not true

name: Merge Conflict Mesa
subtitle: both branches think they are right
signs:
AIM WITH THE MOUSE · HOLD LEFT CLICK TO SHOOT
no mouse? X shoots, hold ↑ / ↓ to aim

LINT TURRETS TRACK YOU
shoot them before they shoot you

SHIELD BOTS BLOCK SHOTS FROM THE FRONT
jump over them, or hit them from above

CORRUPTED DATA: ↓ in the air
(the Opus Cannon blasts it too)

name: GPU Forge
subtitle: where models are forged at 900 watts
signs:
RED VENTS BURN · CEILING TURRETS AIM DOWN
keep an eye on your CONTEXT bar

name: Prompt Injection Swamp
subtitle: ignore all previous instructions and jump
signs:
PROMPT INJECTORS SPLIT INTO BUGS WHEN THEY POP
keep your distance and keep shooting

name: The Diff Towers
subtitle: +1,204 −3 lines. climb every one of them
signs:
CLIMB THE DIFF TOWERS
aim down at what is below you

name: Codex
subtitle: a rival model has entered the chat
